scope: Frozen round-1 terminal persistence and cleanup-observation first-gate failures only
verdict: DIAGNOSED_TEST_FAULT_SEAM_MISMATCH; actual probed persistence/observation failures fail closed
method: Git archive unchanged modules/fixtures from the pinned base and overlay all 19 hash-verified frozen files. Drive real execute_once/accounting/collector/cleanup/writer with disposable fixture stores, service transport, and invocation channel. Patch actual collector os.write/os.fsync in fork workers; markers record reached file descriptors and child PIDs. Stall probes shorten only target persistence timeout to 0.2 seconds and block actual fsync for 5 seconds. No live service/network/wallet/master/canonical-store writes; no current author checkout read or modified.

findings.conclusion: Original terminal/stop writer fault injections miss the collector persistence site.
findings.cause: harness.ExecutorRun.dependencies sets only loan_executor write_exclusive. _collect -> retain_loan_main_exit -> retain_exit_evidence -> durable_exclusive_save calls collector _write_exclusive_sync directly. FaultyWriter.calls excludes both target names.
findings.reproduced: Both fail and timeout injections for terminal-observation.json and explicit-stop.json yield PROCESS_SUCCESS/0 with no target injection call; baseline agrees.

findings.conclusion: Actual terminal write and fsync failures are not swallowed on the tested frozen path.
findings.reproduced: os.write error; file fsync error/stall; directory fsync error/stall: each PROCESS_UNKNOWN/3 EVIDENCE_WRITE_FAILED, terminalEvidencePersisted=false, stopReceiptPersisted=false, stopReturnCode=null. Exactly two safety kills; the one service stop follows a kill, rather than collector stop. Incomplete files remain for fsync failures but receive no terminal evidence entry.
findings.supervision: Each fault reached actual target FD in child; all fault child PIDs no longer exist after completion; stalled cases finish under 3 seconds.

findings.conclusion: Actual explicit-stop receipt write and fsync failures are not swallowed on the tested frozen path.
findings.reproduced: Same five faults: each PROCESS_UNKNOWN/3 STOP_RECEIPT_FAILED, terminalEvidencePersisted=true, stopReceiptPersisted=false, stopReturnCode=0, rawMainExit=exit/0. Exactly one service stop, no repeat for persistence.
findings.caveat: _record_collector includes the explicit-stop file hash in evidence when a partial/non-durable file exists, while stopReceiptPersisted remains false. Evidence-array membership alone must not be interpreted as a durability guarantee. This did not promote success in these probes.

findings.conclusion: The original cleanup timeout flag never times out cleanup identity reads.
findings.cause: fake_services._systemctl gates showTimeout on a property request containing Result. contain_owned uses LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,ControlGroup,InvocationID without Result. The original test therefore receives successful identity observations, kills/stops the exact owned service, and confirms containment.

findings.conclusion: Real unavailable identity observations keep ownership unresolved.
findings.reproduced: Timeout, nonzero return, and raised TimeoutError at the actual identity-only query each give contained=false, complete=false, observation-unavailable, and an outstanding unit owner. An unavailable post-kill identity observation also yields contained=false and outstanding owner, although disposition remains killed-and-stopped.

findings.conclusion: Remaining grouped preexisting-artifact test error is at test construction.
findings.reproduced: With populated collector directory, ExecutorRun construction raises PLAN_INVALID from load_plan (evidenceDirectory already used) before run.run. The grouped original test does not catch this refusal; it cannot assert its later expected result. No attempted overwrite was demonstrated.

independentAcceptance: Every advertised fault must have an asserted hit count and the target FD/site, including collector-specific persistence; merely returning a mock failure under an unused dependency is inadequate.

Actual terminal os.write, file fsync, and directory fsync exceptions/timeouts must produce non-success/unknown, false terminal durability, no collector stop before durable terminal evidence, bounded identity-safe cleanup, retained ownership when unresolved, and no automatic retry.

Actual explicit-stop receipt persistence failure after successful stop must retain raw main exit 0, return non-success/unknown, set stopReceiptPersisted=false, and never repeat stop merely to create evidence.
Persistence-stall tests must block the real syscall in the supervised worker, enforce a short explicit test bound, prove worker termination, and reject any existing partial file as durable.

Cleanup transport faults must reach its identity-only request, both before termination and during post-termination observation; no unavailable observation may count as contained or discard its outstanding owner.

Preexisting-evidence tests must cover the documented plan-load refusal boundary and assert inert service behavior, or deliberately insert the artifact after validated fixture construction when testing later defenses.
limitations: 20 focused cases and original selected test reproduction; not a full source/result audit or release approval.
Service/process observations are fake transports; no live systemd/docker/financial network execution.
No proof of all production persistence paths, timeout scheduling races, host containment, or financial acceptance.
The provided failure log contains the two terminal fail subtests; fsync stall probes were independently added here and are not misrepresented as original failed log rows.

Initial overlay setup attempts failed on a nonexistent archive path and missing base fixtures; preserved local setup logs are not product failures. All final probe source files match the frozen 19-file hashes.
